entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The necromantic shard of Alara, formerly Vithia, cut off from white and green mana and overrun by demons and undead.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The mega-plane from which Grixis split off.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: A white-aligned empire of humans and other races with a dynasty of wise monarchs, which later became Grixis.

entities.name: Sedris
entities.description: The last human king of Vithia, seduced by demons into becoming a lich warlord who rules Sedraxis.

entities.name: Sedraxis
entities.description: The largest necropolis on Grixis, formerly the capital of Vithia, named after Sedris.

entities.name: Vithians
entities.description: The surviving humans of Grixis who still call themselves Vithians and shelter in hermitages.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Evil forces who tempted Sedris and rule castles on Grixis.

entities.name: Necromancers
entities.description: Dark mages whose armies of the dead overran Vithia.

entities.name: Hermitages
entities.description: Remote, ward-covered strongholds where surviving humans shelter.

entities.name: Vis
entities.description: The precious energy of life that necromancers seek to power their spells.

events.summary: Grixis splits from Alara and loses access to white and green mana.
events.quote: But when the subplane became separated from the others, it lost access to its white and green mana.

events.summary: Black mana rises, strengthening necromancers and demons against Vithia.
events.quote: they also had to contend with the rise of black mana

events.summary: Vithia's defenses fail and its citizens fall prey to necromancer armies and demons.
events.quote: Over time, the defenses of Vithia failed.

events.summary: Vithian castles become cities of the dead ruled by necromancer barons, ogre warlords, vampires or demons.
events.quote: proud castles became cities of the dead

events.summary: Demons tempt King Sedris with dreams of power and he falls.
events.quote: Demons, unable to assault the kingdom directly, instead tempted its leader with dreams of power, and he fell.

events.summary: Sedris gives thousands of his subjects to the demons in exchange for lichdom.
events.quote: Sedris handed the lives of thousands of humans in his kingdom to demons in exchange for the power and unlife of a lich.

events.summary: Sedris becomes a lich as his body dies.
Sedris massacres his family and advisors to fuel the ritual preserving his consciousness.
events.quote: Sedris massacred all of his family and close advisors to fuel the bloody ritual

events.summary: Vithia's knights and paladins perish unable to stop him.
events.quote: The knights and paladins of the realm, astonished and unable to assassinate or thwart him

events.summary: Demons and undead flood the kingdom and the capital falls, becoming Sedraxis.
events.quote: The capital fell, and just as Sedris had changed

events.summary: The plane becomes known as Grixis after Sedris's corruption.
events.quote: After the corruption of Sedris, the plane became known as Grixis.

relations.note: Sedris still rules Sedraxis as a lich warlord.
relations.quote: It's still ruled by Sedris, now a lich warlord

relations.note: Sedraxis is named after the last of the Vithian kings.
relations.quote: named after the last of the Vithian kings

relations.note: Sedris bargained with the demons for lichdom.
relations.quote: Sedris handed the lives of thousands of humans in his kingdom to demons in exchange for the power and unlife of a lich.
Grixis split off from the mega-plane of Alara

relations.note: Sedraxis is the largest necropolis on the plane.
relations.quote: the largest necropolis on the plane

relations.note: Surviving Vithians still live in the ruins of Vithia on Grixis.
The living humans fight the forces of undeath.
relations.quote: They fight the forces of undeath with cleverness and magic
